name: Periapt of Health

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: You can't contract a disease, and you have Advantage on saves against being Poisoned.
text: While wearing this pendant, you have Immunity to contracting any disease. If you are already infected with a disease, the effects of the disease are suppressed while you wear the pendant. You also have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
